title: Calculator
description: Standard and scientific calculations with precise decimals, angles and percentages.
expressionHint: Examples: 200 + 10%, sin(30) in DEG, or sin(pi/2) in RAD. Use commas between function arguments.
approximate: ≈ Display rounded to 24 significant digits. Copy uses the full result (up to 80 significant digits).
precision: Uses 80 significant digits. Repeating fractions and irrational numbers are finite precision approximations.
businessHint: Growth: original, new. Discount: price, percentage off. Share: part, whole. Find a part: whole, percentage. Find the whole: part, percentage.
notAllowed: This expression contains unsupported syntax or functions.
tooComplex: The expression is too complex. Shorten it and retry.
nonFinite: The result is undefined or outside the supported numeric range.
name: Calculator
functionHelp: Angles: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan. Logarithms: log10(x), ln(x), log(x, base). Also: abs, round, floor, ceil, sum, mean, min, max. Scientific notation: 1e-6. Select text to wrap it with a function.
keyboardHint: Enter or =: calculate · Esc: clear current expression
noPreviousAnswer: Calculate a result before using Ans.
domainError: The arguments are outside the supported real-number domain.
logDomain: A logarithm needs a positive value and a positive base other than 1.
factorialDomain: A factorial needs a non-negative integer.
combinatoricsDomain: n and r must be integers with 0 ≤ r ≤ n.
tanUndefined: The tangent is undefined at this angle.
